author: cotdmr
quote: This game just lost identity of grand theft auto series. No secret meeting with shoe store employee, can't run over protesters, can't steal cars freely, and can't shoot whatever I want. I can't understand why all the missions are partying, date with lucia, and doing housework. Isn't it should be 'grand theft auto' as it said on title? This game is a pure disappointment. We want chaotic and impressive main characters, not a good citizen and his girlfriend. It's a good game overall, but It shouldn't belong as a grand theft auto series. I can't understand why all the critics rated this game 100.
